THE DREAMLAB KNOWLEDGE MESH · READABLE TIER

A 6.8-million-word corpus of the Fourth Industrial Revolution, compiled into a reasoned formal ontology.

Not a wiki, and not a knowledge graph pretending to be one: this is pure ontology. Every page declares an OWL class with machine-readable semantics, most carry a traceable generation record, and there are zero individuals, by design. The whole corpus compiles losslessly to a formal artefact you can read, follow and cite, machine-checked at build so what you read has been verified, not merely asserted. Read it linearly, or open the explorer as a lens when reading runs out. Three layers do the work; here is what each one means.

A mostly AI-generated synthetic corpus, built under human direction to exercise the VisionFlow toolchain at medium ontology scale. Every page says so.

Search

Most pages carry a signed generation record,
prov:wasAttributedTo
, resolving to five
did:nostr
identities: agent swarms and human direction alike, enumerated in the data

Three layers, read bottom-up

These words get used interchangeably elsewhere; here they name distinct things, and each layer consumes the one beneath it.

1
Ontology
The formal vocabulary: the classes, typed properties and rules that fix what can be said. Every page declares a slice of it in its JSON-LD; this whole site is the ontology in readable form.
2
Knowledge graph
The ontology populated with live instances, at runtime: VisionClaw’s running graph, agents’ working graphs and pod-resident personal graphs assert individuals against these classes. What is said lives there; this site publishes the vocabulary it is said in.
3
Reasoning
The machine check: the pipeline’s EL-profile reasoner gates this ontology at build, and a Whelk EL++ reasoner classifies the runtime graph, rejecting contradictions before they enter it. What follows, verified — never “an LLM thought hard”.
Six domains, one map

Each door opens the explorer at that domain’s subClassOf backbone: orientation first, structure on demand.

Artificial Intelligence

Learning systems, reasoning, agents and the models beneath them.

Distributed ledgers, tokens, identity and cryptographic trust.

Embodied autonomy, sensing, actuation and human–robot interaction.

Sovereign coordination, protocols and the mesh of working peers.

Compute, networks, standards and the ground the rest stands on.

page.title: Dream Machine — evidence-gated nightly repository evolution
headings:
One honest cycle,
          every single night.
An engine, extracted from two routines that already run.
Every night ends in exactly one. Never a fourth, never silence.
